description: This file defines URL patterns for a Django backend related to the 'leads' module, registering various endpoints for lead creation, listing, detail, kanban views, pipeline and stage management, comments, attachments, and lead movement.

classes.name: CreateLeadFromSite
classes.description: View class handling creation of leads from external site form submissions.

classes.name: LeadAttachmentView
classes.description: View class managing lead attachment uploads and downloads.

classes.name: LeadCommentView
classes.description: View class handling comments on leads.

classes.name: LeadUploadView
classes.description: View class for uploading multiple leads or bulk operations.

classes.name: LeadDetailView
classes.description: View class providing detailed information for a specific lead.

classes.name: LeadListView
classes.description: View class listing leads, possibly with filtering.

classes.name: LeadKanbanView
classes.description: View class providing a kanban-style visualization of leads.

classes.name: LeadMoveView
classes.description: View class enabling moving leads between stages or pipelines.

classes.name: LeadPipelineListCreateView
classes.description: View class for listing and creating lead pipelines.

classes.name: LeadPipelineDetailView
classes.description: View class providing details of a specific lead pipeline.

classes.name: LeadStageCreateView
classes.description: View class for creating new stages within a pipeline.

classes.name: LeadStageDetailView
classes.description: View class presenting details of a specific stage.

classes.name: LeadStageReorderView
classes.description: View class for reordering stages within a pipeline.

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Django method to instantiate class-based views as view functions.
